title: feature refine outcome
description: The outcome of `bl refine F-n` (feature-refine.md), written by the agent to the outcome file. `bl refine` sets the feature's status from it (F-68 D3).

summary.description: One line: what the session decided and planned.

premise_holds.description: false: the premise does not hold, and bl sets the feature's status to draft, whatever refined says.

refined.description: Read only when premise_holds is true. true: the feature is ready for approval, and bl sets its status to refined. false: bl leaves the status and prints the reason.

reason.description: One line, for every verdict. premise_holds false: why the premise does not hold. refined false: what keeps the feature from being refined. Both true: why the feature is ready for approval. bl decides from premise_holds, then refined. It prints reason, and records it as the outcome of the log entry when it sets the status.
